stage0068b_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$星刻$$
「As a $$プリベンター$$ agent, apparently
　she was hunting the remnants of $$マリーメイア$$'s army.」

stage0068b_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$星刻$$
「...Our journey's coming to an end too.」

stage0068b_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$五飛$$
「The Chinese Federation...
　Where I first met you...」

stage0068b_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$星刻$$
「That's right.
　You and $$ゼロ$$ saved me here.」

stage0068b_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$星刻$$
「No... it wasn't only me who was saved.
　This nation's people... and the Tianzi too.」

stage0068b_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$五飛$$
「Is this you tagging along to repay that debt?」

stage0068b_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$星刻$$
「That's not all there is to it.
　Worrying for a friend is only natural for a man.」

stage0068b_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$星刻$$
「Listen, $$五飛$$.
　...You're a strong man.
　That much I'll admit.」

stage0068b_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$星刻$$
「But no one is invincible, however strong.
　Everyone falls into a crisis eventually.」

stage0068b_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$星刻$$
「What saves him then is the path he's walked...
　His own life up to that point.」

stage0068b_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$星刻$$
「The bonds born from that
　will surely help him.」

stage0068b_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$星刻$$
「Not just me.
　$$ヒイロ・ユイ$$, $$ゼロ$$, $$紅月カレン$$...
　every one of your comrades is your bond.」

stage0068b_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$星刻$$
「Admit it, $$五飛$$.
　That's the result of your fighting...
　what you've gained by fighting.」

stage0068b_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$星刻$$
「And that's not limited to you alone.
　Every soldier... every person is the same.」

stage0068b_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$星刻$$
「Admit it, $$五飛$$.
　People may be weak creatures,
　but they live by supporting each other...」

stage0068b_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$星刻$$
「And even off the battlefield, a soldier
　fights on in this world, risking their life...
　The fight called living.」

stage0068b_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$星刻$$
「$$五飛$$!
　Am I not fighting!?」

stage0068b_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$星刻$$
「Answer me, $$五飛$$!
　Am I not fighting, now that I can't reach the front!?」

stage0068b_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$星刻$$
「That's right, $$五飛$$.
　As long as one lives, one keeps fighting.」

stage0068b_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$星刻$$
「It's war itself, taking those lives,
　that truly robs us of the fight.」

stage0068b_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$五飛$$
「Hong Kong.
　$c will end up there too, eventually.」

stage0068b_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$五飛$$
「There's a man there who'll answer my doubts.」

stage0068b_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$星刻$$
「Forgive me, $$五飛$$...
　I can no longer stand on the battlefield.」

stage0068b_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$星刻$$
「A tiger and dragon of the gods can't stand together.」

stage0068b_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$五飛$$
「My Gundam now is a twin-headed dragon.」

stage0068b_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$五飛$$
「...If one dragon head is myself,
　the other must be the bond that supports me.」

stage0068b_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$五飛$$
「Farewell, $$黎星刻$$.
　Thank you for the journey until now.」

stage0068b_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$恭子$$
「Oh, Kana...
　We're all going to get Trident-yaki,
　want to come with?」

stage0068b_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Sorry, $$恭子$$.
　I've got something to take care of.」

stage0068b_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$詩織$$
「That again today?
　You've been no fun lately, $$かなめ$$.」

stage0068b_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$恭子$$
「The Volunteer Club activity report again?」

stage0068b_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$詩織$$
「Can't be helped, I guess.
　Not if it's Volunteer Club stuff.」

stage0068b_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$恭子$$
「If Kana doesn't compile everyone's reports,
　Sagara and $l would be marked absent
　and end up held back a year.」

stage0068b_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$詩織$$
「Well, we're heading off...
　Catch up once you're done with the report.」

stage0068b_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$かなめ$$
（That's why I can't involve friends or teachers）

stage0068b_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Something's been going on around me
　this past week... I need to deal with it...）

stage0068b_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$かなめ$$
（$$宗介$$'s gone now.
　$$甲児$$ and $n have their own missions now.
　So I have to do this myself...）

stage0068b_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text: ～ $$プトレマイオス２改$$ Briefing Room ～

stage0068b_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ハンター$$
「Heh... riding aboard a Celestial Being warship
　was unthinkable, not long ago.」

stage0068b_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「We never imagined something like
　welcoming $$ミスリル$$ aboard would happen.」

stage0068b_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ハンター$$
「And on top of that, the Black Knights' $$ゼロ$$ is here...」

stage0068b_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ハンター$$
「Truly a dream team,
　this $c is.」

stage0068b_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Let me introduce him to everyone.
　This is $$ミスリル$$ Intel's East Asia chief,
　$$ギャビン・ハンター$$.」

stage0068b_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ハンター$$
「I'm $$ギャビン・ハンター$$.
　Ah, here's the card for the company I run as a front.」

stage0068b_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Every inch the office worker, huh.」

stage0068b_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$マオ$$
「True enough.
　He'd fit right in at $$２１世紀警備保障$$ or
　Takeo General Company, no question.」

stage0068b_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ハンター$$
「It's no wonder you're surprised.
　My job is mostly management. The fieldwork
　I leave to my subordinates.」

stage0068b_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Now then, $$ハンター$$ will explain to
　everyone about the incident currently
　unfolding in Hong Kong.」

stage0068b_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ハンター$$
「Some of you may already know from the news,
　but for this past week, Hong Kong has been
　under tension from a mysterious AS.」

stage0068b_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「So even $$ミスリル$$ hasn't identified it...」

stage0068b_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ハンター$$
「It appears without warning...
　showing up all over Hong Kong, and each time
　it repeats acts of destruction.」

stage0068b_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Appearing out of nowhere, huh...
　An AS means it's using 《$$ＥＣＳ$$》, then.」

stage0068b_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$カトル$$
「An AS with jamming advanced enough
　to slip past the military's watch net...」

stage0068b_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Nine times out of ten, it's got to be Amalgam.」

stage0068b_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「So we just need to find that mystery AS
　and take it down, is that the idea?」

stage0068b_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$カレン$$
「If it's just chasing one terrorist,
　let's get started right away.」

stage0068b_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ハンター$$
「Please wait.
　The situation isn't that simple.」

stage0068b_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ハンター$$
「The mystery AS's goal is likely
　to turn Hong Kong into a battlefield.」

stage0068b_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Starting a war, all on its own?」

stage0068b_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ハンター$$
「That's right.
　It seems to be trying to be the spark for war.」

stage0068b_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「The Northern and Southern factions, huh.」

stage0068b_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「What are these Northern and Southern factions?」

stage0068b_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ハンター$$
「Hong Kong is a province of the Chinese
　Federation, but it has a complicated history.」

stage0068b_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ハンター$$
「As a result, Hong Kong's politics, economy,
　and culture, everything, is split between the
　Northern and Southern factions, always at odds.」

stage0068b_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ハンター$$
「Both sides have their own forces, practically
　armies, watching for a chance to crush the other.」

stage0068b_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「At that point, it's less a mafia feud
　and more an actual war.」

stage0068b_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「I see...
　So an AS of unknown allegiance has both sides
　suspecting each other and preparing for war.」

stage0068b_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Different methods, but the same goal as Geminis.」

stage0068b_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$スザク$$
「Stoke mutual distrust, and drive it toward war.」

stage0068b_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$n
「And they just sit back and watch, huh.
　That's the lowest kind of tactic.」

stage0068b_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Cases like this aren't limited to Hong Kong
　or the rift between the Federation and Neo Zeon.」

stage0068b_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Skirmishes are breaking out worldwide, and
　the Federation is tied up putting them down.」

stage0068b_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$ signed a wartime treaty
　to keep civilians out of it, but Amalgam and
　Geminis really seem to hate that idea.」

stage0068b_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Even so, to try dragging the world into war
　with such a cowardly scheme...」

stage0068b_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「To keep them from getting their way,
　let's put a stop to this standoff in Hong Kong first.」

stage0068b_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ハンター$$
「Taking all that into consideration,
　we'd like you all to capture that mystery AS.」

stage0068b_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$テッサ$$
「As you've heard, everyone.
　From here, we'll search all of Hong Kong on foot.」

stage0068b_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「It's a small mercy that $c happens
　to have members who are good at
　this kind of mission gathered right now.」

stage0068b_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Each team will investigate its assigned area
　and search for clues to the mystery AS.」

stage0068b_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$キリコ$$
「$$ゴウト$$ and the others headed for 《$$新日本$$》.
　He said to say hello to you all.」

stage0068b_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$キリコ$$... this mission, will you...」

stage0068b_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$キリコ$$
「No need for pointless concern.
　I'll work for my pay.」

stage0068b_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Understood.
　If that's what you say.」

stage0068b_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$宗介$$
（$$キリコ・キュービィー$$...）

stage0068b_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Don't move.
　I've got you covered.」

stage0068b_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$かなめ$$
「It's you...
　The one who's been stalking me all this time.」

stage0068b_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$レイス$$
「So you noticed me...
　Picking up some stranger to enter that hotel
　was just to throw off my watch, was it?」

stage0068b_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That guy? He's out cold in the room.
　Feel a little bad, but he had it coming.」

stage0068b_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$レイス$$
「Still, to get this far without me
　noticing... impressive.」

stage0068b_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「It's not for nothing I'm in the volunteer club.」

stage0068b_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$$ミシェル$$ taught me how to spot
　a sniper's position.」

stage0068b_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$かなめ$$
「And courage... I got that from him.」

stage0068b_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$レイス$$
「I see...
　Seems I underestimated you a bit.」

stage0068b_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$レイス$$
「...I'm with $$ミスリル$$. Your bodyguard.」

stage0068b_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Ha! As if!
　I don't believe you!」

stage0068b_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$レイス$$
「Don't push your luck.
　I can't kill you, but I can still shut
　that smart mouth of yours, easily enough.」

stage0068b_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$レイス$$
「More importantly, this is bad.
　These past few days, I've sensed another tail.」

stage0068b_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$かなめ$$
（What...? What is this girl...?
　She tried to kill me with that knife...!?）

stage0068b_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Could it be... this girl is...
　the tail that guy mentioned...!?）

stage0068b_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$かなめ$$
（What do I do...!?
　I dropped my stun gun in that last attack...
　All I've got left is...）

stage0068b_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$かなめ$$
（This is all $$宗介$$ gave me!）

stage0068b_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$かなめ$$
「The earring he gave me...
　Wasn't a bomb, but it saved me...」

stage0068b_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
???
「An ultra-compact flash grenade, I see.
　You win, for throwing it without hesitation.」

stage0068b_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$レナード$$
「I think there are two kinds of women in this world.
　Those the rain suits, and those it doesn't.」

stage0068b_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$レナード$$
「You're definitely the former, without a doubt.
　Anyone would think so, seeing you right now.」

stage0068b_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Is that... some kind of joke...?」

stage0068b_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$レナード$$
「That's hurtful.
　I meant it as the highest compliment.」

stage0068b_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$レナード$$
「One of your kind.
　I'd like to say I came to save you, but...
　that's not quite true, actually.」

stage0068b_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$レナード$$
「I could have stood by, or I could have helped.
　Either way, the result might not have
　changed at all, though.」

stage0068b_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What an irritating way of talking!
　Can't you just say it straight!?」

stage0068b_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$レナード$$
「Being too blunt isn't great either, I think.
　But maybe that's part of your charm.」

stage0068b_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$かなめ$$
（This hair color... this air about him...
　No way, is he... $$テッサ$$'s...?）

stage0068b_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$レナード$$
「...Wake up, $$玉蘭$$.
　Your sight's already back by now, isn't it?」

stage0068b_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$レナード$$
「She's not someone you can beat.
　Give it up.」

stage0068b_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$レナード$$
「For ignoring the organization's wishes,
　I'll defend you to them.
　Just talk down your sister, rioting in Hong Kong.」

stage0068b_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$レナード$$
「Revenge is such an empty thing.」

stage0068b_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$玉蘭$$
「It's what sensei wanted.
　As long as I live, I'll hunt that woman down.」

stage0068b_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$レナード$$
「Then this is farewell... $$玉蘭$$.」

stage0068b_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$玉蘭$$
「You're the one who'll die, $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$!」

stage0068b_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$玉蘭$$
「What is this thing!?
　Let go! Let go!!」

stage0068b_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$レナード$$
「Response A1.
　Make it certain.」

stage0068b_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$アラストル$$
「Response A1, complete.
　Designated threat fully silenced.」

stage0068b_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$レナード$$
「Plan 1211, $$アラストル$$.
　The world's smallest Arm Slave, you might say.」

stage0068b_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$レナード$$
「So, that just now was my real business here.
　Sorry you had to see something so unpleasant.」

stage0068b_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I-I don't understand what's going on, but...」

stage0068b_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You didn't have to kill her...」

stage0068b_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$レナード$$
「It wasn't me who wanted this outcome.
　It was her, herself.」

stage0068b_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$レナード$$
「Besides, I haven't killed nearly as many people
　as your boyfriend has, you know?」

stage0068b_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$かなめ$$
「H-he's...!
　He's been at war since he was little!
　It can't be helped!」

stage0068b_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「His enemies were all bad guys, anyway...!
　He saves bystanders and anyone weaker than him,
　and he never once enjoys any of it!」

stage0068b_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Anyway, he's... he's not like this!
　He'd never do something like this!」

stage0068b_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$レナード$$
「That logic... you don't actually believe it, do you?」

stage0068b_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$レナード$$
「The act itself is the same, either way.
　And yet you only blame me for it.
　You really do take his side, don't you.」

stage0068b_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$レナード$$
「...Turning down a kiss, and a good one at that.」

stage0068b_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Just what do you think you're doing!?」

stage0068b_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$レナード$$
「A wake-up kiss, maybe?
　Because I've fallen for you.」

stage0068b_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Well, I hate you!
　You make me sick!」

stage0068b_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$レナード$$
「That's exactly what I like about you.
　Fleeting yet fierce, coarse yet noble...
　You're like water, impossible to grasp.」

stage0068b_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$レナード$$
「Heh... before you decide to try killing me,
　I should make my exit.」

stage0068b_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$レナード$$
「$$玉蘭$$'s body still has its uses.
　Retrieve it.」

stage0068b_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$レナード$$
「Just one thing, before goodbye...
　Falling for you was the honest truth.
　I'd like you to believe that, at least.」

stage0068b_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$レナード$$
「Well then, until we meet again...」

stage0068b_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$レイス$$
「No need.
　Even I have my pride.」

stage0068b_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$レイス$$
「This failure...! This disgrace...!
　I'd be better off dead like this...」

stage0068b_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$かなめ$$
（$$宗介$$...
　Because you're not here, this... this happens...
　I... I don't want this...）

stage0068b_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You said, just now, you'd rather be dead, right?」

stage0068b_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Why not struggle a little more?
　I will... from now on, always...!」

stage0068b_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$かなめ$$
「The earring he gave me...
　Wasn't a bomb, but it saved me...」

stage0068b_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
???
「An ultra-compact flash grenade, I see.
　You win, for throwing it without hesitation.」

stage0068b_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$レナード$$
「I think there are two kinds of women in this world.
　Those the rain suits, and those it doesn't.」

stage0068b_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$レナード$$
「You're definitely the former, without a doubt.
　Anyone would think so, seeing you right now.」

stage0068b_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Is that... some kind of joke...?」

stage0068b_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$レナード$$
「That's hurtful.
　I meant it as the highest compliment.」

stage0068b_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$レナード$$
「One of your kind.
　I'd like to say I came to save you, but...
　that's not quite true, actually.」

stage0068b_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$レナード$$
「I could have stood by, or I could have helped.
　Either way, the result might not have
　changed at all, though.」

stage0068b_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What an irritating way of talking!
　Can't you just say it straight!?」

stage0068b_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$レナード$$
「Being too blunt isn't great either, I think.
　But maybe that's part of your charm.」

stage0068b_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$かなめ$$
（This hair color... this air about him...
　No way, is he... $$テッサ$$'s...?）

stage0068b_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$レナード$$
「...Wake up, $$玉蘭$$.
　Your sight's already back by now, isn't it?」

stage0068b_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$レナード$$
「She's not someone you can beat.
　Give it up.」

stage0068b_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$レナード$$
「For ignoring the organization's wishes,
　I'll defend you to them.
　Just talk down your sister, rioting in Hong Kong.」

stage0068b_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$レナード$$
「Revenge is such an empty thing.」

stage0068b_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$玉蘭$$
「It's what sensei wanted.
　As long as I live, I'll hunt that woman down.」

stage0068b_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$レナード$$
「Then this is farewell... $$玉蘭$$.」

stage0068b_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$玉蘭$$
「You're the one who'll die, $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$!」

stage0068b_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$玉蘭$$
「What is this thing!?
　Let go! Let go!!」

stage0068b_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$レナード$$
「Response A1.
　Make it certain.」

stage0068b_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$アラストル$$
「Response A1, complete.
　Designated threat fully silenced.」

stage0068b_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$レナード$$
「Plan 1211, $$アラストル$$.
　The world's smallest Arm Slave, you might say.」

stage0068b_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$レナード$$
「So, that just now was my real business here.
　Sorry you had to see something so unpleasant.」

stage0068b_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I-I don't understand what's going on, but...」

stage0068b_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You didn't have to kill her...」

stage0068b_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$レナード$$
「It wasn't me who wanted this outcome.
　It was her, herself.」

stage0068b_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$レナード$$
「Besides, I haven't killed nearly as many people
　as your boyfriend has, you know?」

stage0068b_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$かなめ$$
「H-he's...!
　He's been at war since he was little!
　It can't be helped!」

stage0068b_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$かなめ$$
「His enemies were all bad guys, anyway...!
　He saves bystanders and anyone weaker than him,
　and he never once enjoys any of it!」

stage0068b_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Anyway, he's... he's not like this!
　He'd never do something like this!」

stage0068b_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$レナード$$
「That logic... you don't actually believe it, do you?」

stage0068b_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$レナード$$
「The act itself is the same, either way.
　And yet you only blame me for it.
　You really do take his side, don't you.」

stage0068b_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Just what do you think you're doing!?」

stage0068b_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$レナード$$
「A wake-up kiss, maybe?
　Because I've fallen for you.」

stage0068b_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Well, I hate you!
　You make me sick!」

stage0068b_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$レナード$$
「That's exactly what I like about you.
　Fleeting yet fierce, coarse yet noble...
　You're like water, impossible to grasp.」

stage0068b_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$レナード$$
「Heh... before you decide to try killing me,
　I should make my exit.」

stage0068b_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$レナード$$
「$$玉蘭$$'s body still has its uses.
　Retrieve it.」

stage0068b_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$レナード$$
「Just one thing, before goodbye...
　Falling for you was the honest truth.
　I'd like you to believe that, at least.」

stage0068b_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$レナード$$
「Well then, until we meet again...」

stage0068b_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$レイス$$
「No need.
　Even I have my pride.」

stage0068b_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$レイス$$
「This failure...! This disgrace...!
　I'd be better off dead like this...」

stage0068b_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$かなめ$$
（$$宗介$$...
　Because you're not here, this... this happens...
　I... I don't want this...）

stage0068b_03:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You said, just now, you'd rather be dead, right?」

stage0068b_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Why not struggle a little more?
　I will... from now on, always...!」

stage0068b_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$アル$$
「Check... confirmed as Sergeant Sagara.
　Yes, Sergeant.」

stage0068b_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$アル$$
「Today's check was satisfactory.
　Maintenance log number 05102101DF001.
　Would you like to view this log?」

stage0068b_03:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$アル$$
「To perform a recheck of the unit,
　the current settings must be changed.
　Exit training mode and connect external power...」

stage0068b_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$宗介$$
「I woke you up on nothing but a whim.」

stage0068b_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$アル$$
「Training message.
　Please explain the meaning of the word 'whim.'」

stage0068b_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$アル$$
「Understood.
　...Complete.
　Shall I report my guess?」

stage0068b_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$アル$$
「Meaning of 'whim'... leading candidate.
　A concept related to caution or doubt.」

stage0068b_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$アル$$
「Second, a concept close to enthusiasm or diligence.
　Third, a concept close to disorder or irregularity.
　Fourth, a concept close to play.」

stage0068b_03:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$アル$$
「Affirmative.
　Is that the concept of a whim?」

stage0068b_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$アル$$
「Understood.
　Thank you for your cooperation.」

stage0068b_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$イアン$$
「So, $$宗介$$.
　Understand $$アル$$... the Arbalest, a little better now?」

stage0068b_03:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Is there any meaning in a dialogue like this?」

stage0068b_03:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Dialogue is the best way to understand each other.」

stage0068b_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「That's right.
　If you want to understand the Arbalest,
　you must also tell him about yourself.」

stage0068b_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$宗介$$
「Him...?
　$$アル$$ is just a computer.
　Not a person.」

stage0068b_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「That's right.
　Between $$アル$$ and me... where's the difference?」

stage0068b_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$宗介$$
「...At least he's a failure.
　A weapons system that won't reliably
　operate on command... that's him.」

stage0068b_03:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$アル$$
「Affirmative.
　The ARX System is incomplete.」

stage0068b_03:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$アル$$
「Affirmative.
　And you are also a cause of that.」

stage0068b_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$アル$$
「The ARX System is one system, including you.
　It cannot be completed without your cooperation.」

stage0068b_03:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$アル$$
「Please tell me what your problem is.
　If you answer, I may be able to offer
　some advice of my own.」

stage0068b_03:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$宗介$$
「...What could you possibly understand about me...」

stage0068b_03:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$宗介$$
「Intuition...? Who taught you that word?
　Then tell that intuition of yours
　to stop the needless guesswork.」

stage0068b_03:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$アル$$
「Your order is nonsense.
　Intuition can't be controlled or persuaded.
　It overflows from the depths of the spirit.」

stage0068b_03:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$宗介$$
「Your talk is the nonsense here!
　Enough with the mockery, already...!」

stage0068b_03:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「You called $$アル$$ a machine, yet you're
　the one arguing with it. Funny, isn't it?」

stage0068b_03:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$イアン$$
「That's how it is, $$宗介$$.
　Somewhere in your heart, you accept $$アル$$ too.」

stage0068b_03:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Don't try to reject what you can't
　understand. That only limits your own potential.」

stage0068b_03:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「It seems $$フィアナ$$'s death shocked you.」

stage0068b_03:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$宗介$$
「...It's strange...
　I've faced people's deaths so many times before...」

stage0068b_03:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「I've lost someone precious to me too...」

stage0068b_03:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$宗介$$...
　You're connecting $$フィアナ$$'s death to the
　idea of your own precious person dying.」

stage0068b_03:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$宗介$$
「Sorry.
　I suppose it's about time for our team to leave.」

stage0068b_03:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$マオ$$
「Change of plans.
　You're staying behind, $$宗介$$.」

stage0068b_03:r_e5de816af15aeaec.text:
$$マオ$$
「I can't trust you to watch my back right now.」

stage0068b_03:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text:
$$マオ$$
「I get the situation.
　But I'm not that nice a big sister.」

stage0068b_03:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$マオ$$
「I refuse to die over your collateral damage.」

stage0068b_03:r_2249da179abb6501.text:
$$宗介$$
「Even you treat me like I'm useless...!」

stage0068b_03:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Have you ever thought about your own death?」

stage0068b_03:r_7fc1d3642481712b.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Don't make that girl feel
　what you're feeling right now.」

stage0068b_03:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$$玉芳$$
「First time we've talked like this, $$相良宗介$$.」

stage0068b_03:r_98c6e74747c3936c.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Right here, in the bed in front of you.」

stage0068b_03:r_60e4d2ebcfd943ea.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Don't go forgetting.
　My Codarl had a Lambda Driver
　installed in it too, you know?」

stage0068b_03:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「That thing can even protect its operator
　from a self-destruct, you know.」

stage0068b_03:r_c0837a2b98000559.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Though, I'm hardly in any state to
　show you my face right now, so
　forgive me for talking through the sheets.」

stage0068b_03:r_290faeefba2fe68d.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Welcome, for what it's worth.
　Glad you followed $$玉芳$$'s lead.」

stage0068b_03:r_65ef57e28bd90298.text:
$$宗介$$
「Nine Dragon... Kowloon...
　That's your alias, isn't it.」

stage0068b_03:r_bbc100b0424fdcd0.text:
$$宗介$$
「Is that woman one of your subordinates?」

stage0068b_03:r_03d92655c99f7c70.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「A student who's practically my own daughter.
　Cute, isn't she?」

stage0068b_03:r_8ca795c4c35fc911.text:
$$宗介$$
「I didn't come here for pointless chatter.
　What are you after?」

stage0068b_03:r_69bf15620a355d50.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Don't be so cold.
　I called you here for exactly
　that kind of pointless chatter.」

stage0068b_03:r_d9ad0726bf16dd92.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Pretty irritable, huh?
　Guess that place just doesn't sit right with you.」

stage0068b_03:r_8cb00be7cca91c45.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「$c and $$ミスリル$$, that's what.
　Stuck in a squad playing at being
　an ally of justice, anyone would get irritated.」

stage0068b_03:r_ce4ee5d4d2a4dc1d.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Especially a man like you.」

stage0068b_03:r_5557ccda2f7c3f23.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Are you done with the sermon?
　Then tell me about the organization
　behind you... Amalgam!」

stage0068b_03:r_01fea60fea66c996.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Heh heh... Unbelievable.
　So the job still comes first, huh?」

stage0068b_03:r_48a3f23147fd6b6d.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「But too bad for you.
　The unrest in Hong Kong has nothing to
　do with Amalgam. I'm just doing it for fun.」

stage0068b_03:r_28066ae0934e6411.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Can't you tell, Kashim?
　Because I wanted to see you.」

stage0068b_03:r_9d00ee0ac3902eac.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Now, don't get so mad.
　Since we finally get to meet, let's talk
　about your fun school life, huh?」

stage0068b_03:r_258a09e5e9761e3d.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Like about $$千鳥かなめ$$, for instance.」

stage0068b_03:r_263097ee015a04ab.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Are there people in Amalgam
　called $$ウィスパード$$?」

stage0068b_03:r_4a301748a7930689.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Yes.
　One of them's become a key member.」

stage0068b_03:r_c38e739de7ee864a.text:
$$宗介$$
「If you have a $$ウィスパード$$, why target
　Chidori!? There shouldn't be any need!」

stage0068b_03:r_5135fdea02c6bd7b.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Because it's not perfect.
　The knowledge a $$ウィスパード$$ brings,
　they say, varies from one to another.」

stage0068b_03:r_c545a5a303470d2c.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Some are strong in Lambda Driver theory,
　others can barely muster submarine tech.」

stage0068b_03:r_fb06b0a658b1ef40.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「So when a new $$ウィスパード$$ turns up,
　we need to find which field they're strong in.
　That test on her in Hanka was for exactly that.」

stage0068b_03:r_e5630cc47dc440b7.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「As a result, we found out $$千鳥かなめ$$'s
　a $$ウィスパード$$. That's all I was told, though.」

stage0068b_03:r_8f39e18936c36a15.text:
$$宗介$$
「Where's Amalgam's base!?
　Who are its key members!?」

stage0068b_03:r_f2655371e3ef7b59.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「No point talking about that.
　Let's use our time more wisely.」

stage0068b_03:r_959b2fde0469959d.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「'Please,' huh...
　Are you really that Kashim I knew?」

stage0068b_03:r_586ac0e9503b5765.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Try to remember.
　Five years ago, when we first met
　in $$ヘルマジスタン$$, what were you doing?」

stage0068b_03:r_1d13d9bb6a6d7818.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Back then, I ran a mercenary training camp,
　and you were a guerrilla fighting the foreign
　forces meddling there. Not allies, not enemies.」

stage0068b_03:r_dc37213133cd8177.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Even now, I remember it so well...
　Back then, you had truly good eyes.」

stage0068b_03:r_9b8d839e83da7879.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Neither denying nor affirming life.
　No worry, no hesitation, no suffering.
　Yeah... eyes like a saint's.」

stage0068b_03:r_95a0cdf4151c12f7.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「I suppose you could call that beautiful.」

stage0068b_03:r_855e82ce06693ee8.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Get it?
　In other words, consistency.
　No contradictions at all.」

stage0068b_03:r_3c1c81e93f697fb9.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「When we met again in Hanka, your eyes
　were just as beautiful, unchanged...
　the eyes of someone with no human weakness.」

stage0068b_03:r_10cbf30c54cfe4fc.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Killing you like that seemed like it'd
　be pretty good... Or so I thought...
　So what's with that face now?」

stage0068b_03:r_cc01b694a39de719.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「What an awful face...!
　Worried? Hesitating?
　Where'd that saintly you go?」

stage0068b_03:r_6a5a0a8d6d6a68fd.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「What a letdown.
　You're nothing but contradictions now.
　Not even worth killing...」

stage0068b_03:r_fa54b106906131ec.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Just like I said back on that submarine.
　You've gotten weak.」

stage0068b_03:r_c98d1f9a0e601947.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「You're the same breed as me, so why
　are you trying to act like some normal
　guy now? It makes me sick.」

stage0068b_03:r_afa4e4bac1376010.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'm telling you to shut up!」

stage0068b_03:r_c5f074a439f6c890.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「No, I'll say it.
　Meeting $$ミスリル$$ and those school
　brats made you pathetic.」

stage0068b_03:r_8b22d4b99ca35b84.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Dragged down by those worthless
　nobodies, you went and got boring.」

stage0068b_03:r_b0aaf075b2a97a36.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「I said you seemed irritated earlier,
　remember? That's their fault.
　Humanism, that's what it is.」

stage0068b_03:r_53add6e443d8a65a.text:
$$宗介$$
（The hesitation I'm carrying...
　is because of Jindai High and $c...）

stage0068b_03:r_447e23c61fa29c56.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「That kind of thing doesn't suit Kashim
　the killing saint. They played you for a fool.」

stage0068b_03:r_d95bdcd1bd8b6579.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Listen, the weak parasitize the strong.
　Dangling kind friends, trust, and the like,
　they suck a strong one's power dry to the bone.」

stage0068b_03:r_2b4d4dced3ef5a03.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Tell me the truth.
　Is it fun, running with the weak?」

stage0068b_03:r_0c888ad00ef30dc4.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Answer me, come on!
　I'm asking if it's fun, running with
　the weak. Well?」

stage0068b_03:r_bee2bfb994ca7365.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Guess you don't even have the guts to kill.」

stage0068b_03:r_4d54e46ed7fd462d.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「$$玉芳$$'s scheme will soon turn Hong Kong
　into a sea of flames. She worked hard for me.」

stage0068b_03:r_1c42d2bca3a5e3a3.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Her little sister $$玉蘭$$ too.
　I ordered her to kill the biggest cancer
　that corrupted you.」

stage0068b_03:r_0491c741ae20f5e6.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Word hasn't reached you yet, I guess?
　I heard the whole thing.
　That cute uniform of hers, all torn to shreds.」

stage0068b_03:r_131bea3d5d957e98.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Gutsy of her, she didn't beg for her life.
　Her last words were 'sorry...'」

stage0068b_03:r_18ef8ab6be368d72.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Now who was that meant for, I wonder?
　Makes you cry, huh...」

stage0068b_03:r_ae2ea53f43e74074.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「It's true!
　I wanted to show you that photo here,
　and see the despair on your face.」

stage0068b_03:r_60e8a3284b8a113b.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Well, I'll let that slide.
　After all... Kashim, the damage really shows.」

stage0068b_03:r_e745974656b70e6a.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Aww～, poor $$かなめ$$-chan!
　She was such a good girl～!」

stage0068b_03:r_d4f3fe1e9bcf2590.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「That's right, I killed her!
　Now, hate me! Hate me, Kashiiiim!!」

stage0068b_03:r_521653467873650f.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「That's right, Kashim.
　Not seeing through a trick like this,
　you'd completely lost your head.」

stage0068b_03:r_aab85855cbaf5596.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「See ya, Kashim.
　In five seconds, this room goes boom.」

stage0068b_03:r_f3ed55718d2364ba.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Bridge

stage0068b_03:r_47fd2ac2e2a8e945.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Bridge

stage0068b_03:r_95ef381ed0b96982.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Bridge

stage0068b_03:r_82218191e135e576.text: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Bridge ～

stage0068b_03:r_c4e4b578079583c5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...$$マデューカス$$,
　please fit the ARX-7 with an emergency
　deployment booster. Load the Boxer shotgun.」

stage0068b_03:r_46c21ad643c64977.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「With respect, Captain.
　Sergeant Sagara is unreachable, and I can
　only conclude he's abandoned his mission.」

stage0068b_03:r_6a27ef5c3933ffa2.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Relying on that unreliable AS and that man
　is clearly a mistake.」

stage0068b_03:r_1be6bea3e5d25074.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「This isn't some school club activity!」

stage0068b_03:r_2471e14c1ef0ecac.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I know that!
　Are you lecturing me now, of all times?」

stage0068b_03:r_6c3c0ada303bce08.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「No! Not this time, I will not stay silent!
　You're letting personal feelings cloud your judgment!」

stage0068b_03:r_9f5a27f5febf371b.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「What of the organization and military law!
　Giving special treatment to an NCO who
　abandoned his duty is out of the question!」

stage0068b_03:r_c5d536c5ba8c0902.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Fine.
　Then who is it that's been piling endless
　impossible burdens onto that one NCO?」

stage0068b_03:r_61c5480dbf2e58e0.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It's us!
　If you disagree, say so now!」

stage0068b_03:r_2e966de2770bb703.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Have you forgotten how much he's
　helped us, time and time again!?」

stage0068b_03:r_ddda297a7997c73b.text:
$$テッサ$$
「In Hanka, in Odaiba, and during the seajacking,
　who was it that protected us!?
　Tell me, who was it!?」

stage0068b_03:r_fda7edf39e317875.text:
$$テッサ$$
「That's right.
　And still you would blame him?
　Brand him a coward?」

stage0068b_03:r_c627120a60cde94d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「If you want me to admit it, fine.
　I have feelings for him.」

stage0068b_03:r_22a2d3667e5a9fc8.text:
$$テッサ$$
「But that has nothing to do with this.
　He'll surely come through again.
　He won't abandon us...」

stage0068b_03:r_62e68b17a29fb53b.text:
$$テッサ$$
「No matter how bad things are right now,
　he'll pull through and come back to us!」

stage0068b_03:r_3f09ae47d355cbc5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「A person's true nature doesn't change!
　Because he is strong and kind!」

stage0068b_03:r_629b0e87b7bc7b76.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Strong and kind...
　Captain, and you expect that to convince me?」

stage0068b_03:r_5777cb06f7e0103f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「That isn't the point, is it?
　What you doubt is my own judgment!」

stage0068b_03:r_ede6dd5bb2efe029.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Lt. Colonel Richard $$マデューカス$$,
　do you believe in me?
　Or do you not?」

stage0068b_03:r_98e716ed18b1b3a2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「As captain, I have protected this ship
　right up until today. Choose this very
　$$テレサ・テスタロッサ$$...! Now, choose!」

stage0068b_03:r_91a4ece3cc02badd.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「...You have grown strong.」

stage0068b_03:r_e81e034b71411af7.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Aye, ma'am!
　Fitting the ARX-7 with the emergency
　deployment booster and Boxer shotgun!」

stage0068b_03:r_bc5b33fbc100b97b.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「But without knowing where Sergeant Sagara is...」

stage0068b_03:r_f2d72b948cc38cfe.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Let's wait.
　For him to make contact.」

stage0068b_03:r_444bfe868b096710.text:
$$五飛$$
「You truly are a well-trained soldier.
　The instant the blast hit, you leaped for
　the window and took the fall from the 3rd floor.」

stage0068b_03:r_f8c886fa821c5334.text:
$$宗介$$
「I... I lost the one thing that mattered most...」

stage0068b_03:r_2e5685a3629d0a5e.text:
$$宗介$$
「There was never a future to begin with...
　Kill each other, die, however you like...」

stage0068b_03:r_ce4b924038c181a0.text:
$$五飛$$
「You've lost your soul, have you...」

stage0068b_03:r_1054a335fa977a7a.text:
$$五飛$$
「I see, $$星刻$$...
　So this is what it means for war to steal a soul...」

stage0068b_03:r_1ce9868e47e05f97.text:
$$五飛$$
「Then let me ask you this.
　As long as you have $$千鳥かなめ$$,
　is that all you need to go on living?」

stage0068b_03:r_b302a6e2e0ca76ec.text:
$$宗介$$
「What's the point of a question like that!?」

stage0068b_03:r_e4166e8a5b45cb96.text:
$$五飛$$
「Never mind.
　You'll have your answer soon enough.」

stage0068b_03:r_bdfc9cb5d9aaf4ce.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Like I care about your business...」

stage0068b_03:r_1711e6c6939aa411.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I asked where you think you're going!」

stage0068b_03:r_63bcb74b5bb605c9.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What kind of dumb reaction is that!」

stage0068b_03:r_99128140e453d460.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What is with that reaction!
　After all the trouble I went through to get here!」

stage0068b_03:r_bdf41f6a0fb7b286.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Until a second ago I was so dramatically
　worked up, I was ready to fall right into
　your arms, but what was that!?」

stage0068b_03:r_3e40a7aae6a7ebad.text:
$$かなめ$$
「'You're alive...?' you said?
　That seriously pisses me off!」

stage0068b_03:r_d4488f1ef5175d87.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Honestly, I'm not even in the mood anymore!
　What are you going to do about it!?
　How are you gonna take responsibility for this!?」

stage0068b_03:r_4f98756e8506f766.text:
$$宗介$$
「W-wait, Chidori...
　Weren't you killed by $$ガウルン$$'s men...?」

stage0068b_03:r_99e939138611b349.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Hurt? That hurt, didn't it?
　That's the pain in my heart!
　And next, this! The pain in my body!」

stage0068b_03:r_b8aead2ff492ad33.text:
$$かなめ$$
「And this! This is the pain
　of my very soul!!」

stage0068b_03:r_f2a506c32c68b595.text:
$$五飛$$
「Guess I'm not needed here anymore.」

stage0068b_03:r_366eed12d0fa7297.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Thanks, $$五飛$$.
　For guiding me all the way here.」

stage0068b_03:r_db902169b0ec12e0.text:
$$五飛$$
「I owed $$ギャビン・ハンター$$ one, anyway.
　And I got to see something interesting too.」

stage0068b_03:r_bccb0c4cb58aa146.text:
$$五飛$$
「$$相良宗介$$.
　I did get my answer from you.」

stage0068b_03:r_0ee1b4c987332e23.text:
$$かなめ$$
「He's admirable.
　Not much older than us, and yet
　he thinks about so much.」

stage0068b_03:r_96d6ee6ffbd6d1e6.text:
$$宗介$$
「What in the world is going on...?
　Chidori... why are you here...?」

stage0068b_03:r_86a99be7bc977b4a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Obviously!
　I came here to see you!」

stage0068b_03:r_d85829b2f9bff450.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I nearly died, and thought about a lot,
　and I decided to say it properly...!
　What I mean is, I... about you...!」

stage0068b_03:r_85121e18387bbee9.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...Never mind.
　I guess resolve fades after a day, huh.」

stage0068b_03:r_5cf3d385c6d4b8d0.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Argh! Never mind!
　More importantly, what are you doing!?
　$n and $$カレン$$ and the others are fighting!」

stage0068b_03:r_f6f98a8ef73d1d43.text:
$$宗介$$
「I can't move it, that machine...
　And I left you behind...!」

stage0068b_03:r_3d395121b4205722.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Is that why you can't find the strength?」

stage0068b_03:r_980e935235423ee4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So you wanted to just throw it all away?」

stage0068b_03:r_cbab585f941e5667.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You got tired, didn't you?
　Couldn't bring yourself to say it, right?」

stage0068b_03:r_0e1caed2ba333f4e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$... you're so serious and faint of heart,
　that's why you couldn't do anything, right?」

stage0068b_03:r_7aac40a4f34dcec3.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But, you're strong.
　So very kind.
　A hopeless case, but you make it work...」

stage0068b_03:r_371b88cba6c82378.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's the kind of guy I thought you were.」

stage0068b_03:r_e174d36b825c4290.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Forget about that!
　Everyone's in trouble, right!?
　Get going already and finish this!」

stage0068b_03:r_c1cddb7853813703.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「So you're finally back, and it's with a girl.」

stage0068b_03:r_497aca854c5f874d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...Maybe that wasn't such a good idea after all...
　Boarding all the way onto a warship.」

stage0068b_03:r_1797d61f82be363c.text:
$n
「There's nothing for Chidori to worry about.
　$$宗介$$ will explain everything properly.」

stage0068b_03:r_f2e19618032127d3.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Knowing him, he's probably going to trot out
　some crackpot logic again, isn't he?」

stage0068b_03:r_9d5428667d48c806.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Not really.
　$$宗介$$... he's grown up a lot these past few weeks.」

stage0068b_03:r_21454fd877c0ae7b.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「If you've got an excuse, I'm listening, Sergeant.」

stage0068b_03:r_c8c3a682c9917367.text:
$$宗介$$
「She... $$千鳥かなめ$$ is a protectee of $$ミスリル$$.
　In carrying out that duty, I simply chose
　the most effective method available.」

stage0068b_03:r_f612b6b60810e300.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Heh... Very well.
　I'll authorize her to come aboard.」

stage0068b_03:r_4ff0d278b79d1168.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Finding your own reason to fight, on your own...
　You've grown, Sergeant.」

stage0068b_03:r_b101d62bbac1b33b.text:
$$五飛$$
「But you still have far to go.
　You've only climbed the first step from soldier to warrior.」

stage0068b_03:r_05b808b1583f5be2.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「He's right.
　The lectures continue, then.」

stage0068b_03:r_72be9250b889c959.text:
$$五飛$$
「Show me where your fight leads.」

stage0068b_03:r_402b4aaf0ee30986.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Man, look at $$五飛$$...
　Already settled right into the squad.」

stage0068b_03:r_2cfc9851abe4070e.text:
$$カレン$$
「Bet he and Lieutenant $$クルーゾー$$ get along.」

stage0068b_03:r_0831afdf480052ed.text:
$$カトル$$
「It's not just $$宗介$$...
　$$五飛$$'s grown too.」

stage0068b_03:r_1c9bf7ffbf9314a5.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Tch... Wrapped up in a mood that warm,
　it's hardly the moment to complain.」

stage0068b_03:r_adc5793509f8d46c.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Yeah, well.
　Guess I'll just say I'm happy this time, for once.」

stage0068b_03:r_c5ffa17ba0fae8d3.text:
$$宗介$$
「Sorry, Chidori.
　There's something I have to do now.」

stage0068b_03:r_abc1d4645695a0e0.text:
$$宗介$$
「Yeah.
　So our everyday life doesn't come to an end.」

stage0068b_03:r_ae527ac0a641a269.text:
$$カレン$$
「It's okay, $$かなめ$$.
　Let's trust $$宗介$$.」

stage0068b_03:r_b76534e2de5b6334.text:
$n
「That's right.
　This guy will always see it through.」

stage0068b_03:r_357749a704e3cf55.text:
$$カレン$$
「Lucky you, $n.
　Didn't have to go bald after all.」

stage0068b_03:r_9da55d8320b82bc6.text:
$n
「Not the slightest doubt in my mind.」

stage0068b_03:r_7accc1b1cfd86010.text:
$n
「He's my friend.
　And a man worth trusting.」

stage0068b_03:r_301d85713d2cddd7.text: $$プトレマイオス２改$$ Briefing Room

stage0068b_03:r_59a1074cc884fdbd.text: $$プトレマイオス２改$$ Briefing Room

stage0068b_03:r_b66bbe1f07a7674e.text: $$プトレマイオス２改$$ Briefing Room

stage0068b_03:r_b77f3e5c390fe067.text: ～ $$プトレマイオス２改$$ Briefing Room ～

stage0068b_03:r_39d8b5a2657c65a4.text:
$$アミット$$
「To defy us with such intimidation tactics...!
　I've never felt this much anger before, Sergeant!」

stage0068b_03:r_1a123affe838b8b1.text:
$$テッサ$$
「But he's the only one who can operate the Arbalest.」

stage0068b_03:r_fb72b64c842ba487.text:
$$アミット$$
「Silence, Captain!
　As Intelligence Director, his demand is absurd!」

stage0068b_03:r_f9ff2a77c392a048.text:
$$宗介$$
「General, sir, I am merely proposing
　a change to the terms of the contract.」

stage0068b_03:r_3167d694c10c96fb.text:
$$宗介$$
「If this doesn't suit you,
　I'll simply pay the penalty and leave this unit.」

stage0068b_03:r_54e755252ec3acc4.text:
$$アミット$$
「Bold words, Sergeant.
　Do you truly think you can live as you please
　after making an enemy of me?」

stage0068b_03:r_5dcadcd6c77bc7dc.text:
$$宗介$$
「Then let me ask you, General.
　Do you think I lack the resolve
　to see this through?」

stage0068b_03:r_97923e3dd5dae64b.text:
$$宗介$$
「I never sold my soul to $$ミスリル$$!
　I'll stick to my own way of doing things,
　that's all.」

stage0068b_03:r_c8b34405ed7bfde7.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'll keep piloting the Arbalest.
　And keep attending that school.
　Same as always.」

stage0068b_03:r_286cd6be5271ecd2.text:
$$宗介$$
「And I'll take half the pay for it.
　Is there a problem with that?」

stage0068b_03:r_4b3e91da51d87c72.text:
$$宗介$$
「Save that for a bird of passage!
　Say that to your own pet dog instead!」

stage0068b_03:r_5f455447e0703bcf.text:
$$マロリー$$
「You've lost, General.
　A skilled $$ＳＲＴ$$ operative is offering
　to work for half the pay.」

stage0068b_03:r_378632856490e9d0.text:
$$マロリー$$
「There's no reason to be angry.
　Wouldn't you all agree, gentlemen?」

stage0068b_03:r_0a93eeae43e226f4.text:
$$ボーダ$$
「Well, I suppose so.
　Though not something to say too openly.」

stage0068b_03:r_49dde825db6b02a0.text:
$$マロリー$$
「Well, that settles it, Captain Testarossa.
　...Seems you've got nothing but quirky subordinates.」

stage0068b_03:r_5d3ee1804aedfa48.text:
$$テッサ$$
「No, my subordinates are the best there is.」

stage0068b_03:r_7fd3cd80460fefb1.text:
$$マロリー$$
「And Sergeant... $$相良宗介$$, was it?」

stage0068b_03:r_0f9b6f684aa8f438.text:
$$マロリー$$
「I'll remember your name.
　...Well then, good luck to you all.」

stage0068b_03:r_23d7f155539c7c51.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「So those are $$ミスリル$$'s top brass.」

stage0068b_03:r_c8e48adccc9bbba8.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm sorry.
　For letting us use the Ptolemaios
　for such a secretive meeting.」

stage0068b_03:r_cd3b88564d0672c9.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「It's fine, $$テッサ$$.
　Everyone aboard this ship has been
　curious about $$宗介$$'s future anyway.」

stage0068b_03:r_ed6e99341ad5bf40.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Anyway, seems things settled where they should.」

stage0068b_03:r_7ff5aecfd0f37b20.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Still, that was a cold-sweat moment, Sergeant.
　Don't add to my worries so much.」

stage0068b_03:r_a378a46f62b5980d.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「You're starting to look like a man now.」

stage0068b_03:r_f0ce8e3e0d75533e.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Then, Sergeant Sagara, with that face
　of a man now, go and properly
　explain the past and present to Captain Testarossa.」

stage0068b_03:r_5aa4e72c511af6eb.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Then, I'll join you as well...」

stage0068b_03:r_8e2f92d078970a2b.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「I need to speak with Executive Officer
　$$マデューカス$$ about future strategy.」

stage0068b_03:r_e8ecfd162319c1e6.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「But, leaving him alone with the captain...」

stage0068b_03:r_84158af5a79e4d35.text:
$$テッサ$$
「B-before I hear your report,
　there's something I need to say first!」

stage0068b_03:r_4c845bb8b05d3b13.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...I'm sorry about back then.
　For saying such awful things to you...」

stage0068b_03:r_836fc0eae35929e9.text:
$$宗介$$
「No... I'm the one who should apologize.」

stage0068b_03:r_aed2fc42c9a9ecdd.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It's all right.
　I forgot my place...
　I suppose I was leaning on you too much.」

stage0068b_03:r_ebc3eec9f9e218b1.text:
$$テッサ$$
「But... so... are we... still friends, right?」

stage0068b_03:r_778c6eb2f5afc622.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Captain, if you'll grant that I'm your friend,
　would you permit a somewhat blunt remark?」

stage0068b_03:r_6095c82e60cdd7af.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「So this is where you were.
　I called and got no answer, then noticed
　this room's comms had been cut off.」

stage0068b_03:r_f19a063712278769.text:
$$テッサ$$
（Just when... just when Sagara
　finally got to call me $$テッサ$$...
　And I never even heard what came after...）

stage0068b_03:r_48fd2b5d0978ba1c.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「A- a grave situation has arisen.
　Neo Zeon's $$シャア・アズナブル$$ has requested
　a meeting with $c.」

stage0068b_03:r_3c39aed29379134c.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Not to the Earth Federation,
　but naming $c specifically,
　he may be seeking reconciliation with Captain $$アムロ$$.」

stage0068b_03:r_9520c4f160aa3ebd.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「It could well be a trap.
　So we should gather every unit in space,
　where the meeting will be held.」

stage0068b_03:r_9dc3c6963e7dac77.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Understood.
　Have the Ptolemaios continue
　on into space as it is.」

stage0068b_03:r_e839f83a2e7828b1.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Could this be a step toward ending the war...」

stage0068b_03:r_0d848a222f69347d.text:
$$カトル$$
「You're as strong as ever, $$五飛$$.」

stage0068b_03:r_bd5c0088c2d22ef6.text:
$$五飛$$
「I'm nothing but a fool.
　Your words don't suit a man like that.」

stage0068b_03:r_77fc21c69be0890c.text:
$$カトル$$
「Being able to admit your own weakness
　like that, I think, is your strength.」

stage0068b_03:r_a0fcf4d8788a2bce.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$カトル$$ and the others always believed
　you'd surely rejoin us someday, Master $$五飛$$.」

stage0068b_03:r_d8483ee925825d04.text:
$$五飛$$
「So in the end, I just took a detour...」

stage0068b_03:r_dae622560a4cfc83.text:
$$カトル$$
「That's not true, $$五飛$$.
　You've come back stronger than before.」

stage0068b_03:r_aa09da82b4c52a2a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$五飛$$'s demonic fighting prowess
　earned us 100 Z Chips.
　I'll add these to the squad's stock.」

stage0068b_03:r_d0acd2176373fca3.text:
$$五飛$$
（What I've gained can't be measured like that...）

stage0068b_03:r_c2f74d776b632961.text:
$$五飛$$
（$$セイナ$$, $$星刻$$... my thanks to you too.
　I'll walk my own path of battle.）

stage0068b_03:r_e4dc8237ad7169a2.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...See you, $$宗介$$.
　I'm heading back to Japan first.」

stage0068b_03:r_ced1bbcf059b07d7.text:
$$宗介$$
「Sorry, Chidori.
　I couldn't stay by your side to protect you.」

stage0068b_03:r_dda2f4922920a4e0.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I told you, I'm fine.
　I can hold my own, you know.」

stage0068b_03:r_d96c64f9a77d53aa.text:
$$宗介$$
「You two... when did you get so close?」

stage0068b_03:r_da78018881956191.text:
$$レイス$$
「It's not that kind of relationship...!」

stage0068b_03:r_4267b07b216d5d90.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Right, isn't it?
　More like forced submission than friendship.」

stage0068b_03:r_02b69055356d9cfb.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But I really am grateful, mister.
　You brought us all the way to Hong Kong.」

stage0068b_03:r_c4554163734c62f1.text:
$$レイス$$
（How pathetic...
　To think I must obey a little girl,
　just to keep my failed mission quiet...）

stage0068b_03:r_890ab04baf542979.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But you... that's quite the disguise technique.」

stage0068b_03:r_0b8e88db1a9dd44e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Since this is a good opportunity,
　would you let us see your real face?」

stage0068b_03:r_a4798a17c691a81a.text:
$$レイス$$
「As if I could do that!」

stage0068b_03:r_31f18ff9dc8f076e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But there's our future trust to think of...
　I want to see it too.」

stage0068b_03:r_3cf33f3773748d0f.text:
$$宗介$$
「You've lost, $$レイス$$.
　Chidori goes all out once she finds your weak point.」

stage0068b_03:r_b06b2a23a76e8ce4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, now that your spirit's broken,
　let me ask for one more thing.」

stage0068b_03:r_cbff35a90e8ad7cd.text:
$$レイス$$
「...At this point, I've given up caring.
　Just this once.」

stage0068b_03:r_26db4dd6c24f9835.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「All right, here we go!
　Let's get fired up today too!」

stage0068b_03:r_180eb1536d754e3c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Got myself a treasure of a scene!!」
